cohort: 476 mother-child pairs from the Project Viva pre-birth cohort in Eastern Massachusetts, excluding those with maternal type 1 or 2 diabetes and gestational age <34 weeks
finding: Birth weight-for-gestational age z-score was associated with DNA methylation at 34 CpG sites in cord blood and 4 CpG sites in mid-childhood blood.
mod_finding: The study controlled for mode of delivery but did not find significant associations between it and the primary outcome (DNA methylation).
